answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use quartz-timed proof of elapsed work: each newcomer must complete a verifiable delay task anchored to a quartz clock, which takes real wall-clock time and cannot be parallelised, so spawning a thousand fakes costs a thousand sequential waits. Work is then pressed into shale-like layers of public history, each attested by a different peer, and only identities with many layers may touch high-value jobs. A saffron-rare bonus is paid only on work that survives a random audit, so cheap copies earn nothing while real work compounds.
